key_idea: Dijkstra on a lexicographic key (distance, -items): among equal-distance relaxations keep the one with more items.
sketch: Run O(n^2) Dijkstra with n<=100, storing for each node the shortest distance and the max items collectable over shortest paths to it. Relax when the distance is strictly smaller or equal with more items; when extracting, break distance ties by larger item count (not strictly needed since edge weights are positive, so all equal-distance predecessors are finalized first). Start with items[1]=t1. Print impossible if n is unreachable (m may be 0).
